info.name: VibeCore CRUD and RBAC
info.description: Local-only CRUD regression. Run in order against the disposable database using npm run test:postman. Creates fixture records and deletes them at the end. No production URLs or embedded credentials.

exec: if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)(:\d+)?\/?$/.test(base)) throw new Error('Regression collection requires a localhost API.');
pm.test('Wishlist empty after reading starts', () => pm.expect(payload.data.some(w => String(w.bookId) === String(pm.collectionVariables.get('bookId')))).to.eql(false));
pm.test('Progress persisted', () => { const row = payload.data.find(a => String(a.id) === String(pm.collectionVariables.get('readingId'))); pm.expect(row.currentPage).to.eql(42); });
